furnace to emit a redstone signal
depending on how many items are in it.
Additionally, there is a comparator with
subtraction mode which allows you to
offset the amount of redstone signal
that is outputed by the furnace. You can
increase it by pressing the plus or
shiftclick to decrease it. While the red
and the green augments might be
self-explanatory, I understand that the
blue augments might need further
explanation. Here we have a set of iron
furnaces in their logical upgrade path
from iron to netherite. We take a look
behind them. You can see that they are
cabled by an ultimate energy cube from
mechanism. We can now give each of these
output. Note that any form of RF
transportation will work, but for this
example, I am simply using mechanism.
Now, we can take a look at each of the
individual furnaces interfaces. Starting
with iron, you can see that the furnace
now has two input and output slots, as
well as an energy bar and a button.
